The '''Sabrash system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Kastolar sector/Legends|Kastolar sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[Kashyyyk Region/Legends|Kashyyyk Region]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> The system was the origin point of the group known as the [[Sabrashi]],<ref name="NEGtWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Sabrashi]] and [[Sabrashi Bio-Chemical Deterrents, Inc.]]|system=Sabrash [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> and shared its name with the company [[Sabrashi Bio-Chemical Deterrents, Inc.]]<ref name="Galladinium">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Sabrash system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed the system in grid square R-9.<ref name="TEA" />
